verdict.rationale: OpenAI's docs extensively cover function/tool calling with typed schemas, parallel and multi-step calls, structured outputs, built-in tools, and an explicit Agents guide describing multi-step planning and tool orchestration, backed by official SDKs (Python, etc.) enabling agent loops. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on benchmark specifically validating parallel/multi-step tool-call reliability (community evidence is about general coding performance, not tool-calling fidelity).
